مَغْسُولٌ : see غَسِيلٌ. ―
-b2- Hence one says, كَلَامُهُ مَغْسُولٌ, meaning (assumed tropical:) His speech, or language, is devoid of nice, or subtile, expressions or allusions; as though it were washed from such; or deserving to be washed and obliterated: or it may mean (tropical:) trimmed, or pruned. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
